The simple preparation of this steak dish belies its complex taste profile.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Prime Spiced Meat Skewers are made by [[Cooking]] [[Raw Prime Meat]] and [[Goron Spice]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. By eating them, [[Link]] can have some of his [[Heart]]s restored in his [[Life Gauge]]. Though the preparation of these Skewers is simple, they are known to have a complex taste profile. Link can add more [[Ingredient]]s when making Prime Spiced Meat Skewers, which can result in the following variations: * '''Chilly Prime Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Prime Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
The simple preparation of this steak dish belies its complex taste profile.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding chilly Ingredients. Link will gain one level of [[Heat Resistance]] when he eats these skewers. * '''Electro Prime Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Prime Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
The simple preparation of this steak dish belies its complex taste profile.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric Ingredients. If they are eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Prime Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Prime Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
The simple preparation of this steak dish belies its complex taste profile.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring Ingredients. Eating these skewers will completely restore and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Energizing Prime Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Prime Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The simple preparation of this steak dish belies its complex taste profile.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing Ingredients. They can be eaten to refill a portion of Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Hasty Prime Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Prime Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
The simple preparation of this steak dish belies its complex taste profile.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty Ingredients. Link can eat them to have his movement speed increased. * '''Hearty Prime Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Prime Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The simple preparation of this steak dish belies its complex taste profile.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty Ingredients. When eaten, they will heal all of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum Hearts. * '''Mighty Prime Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Prime Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The simple preparation of this steak dish belies its complex taste profile.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty Ingredients. Consuming them will grant Link a boost to the power of his attacks. * '''Sneaky Prime Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Prime Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
The simple preparation of this steak dish belies its complex taste profile.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky Ingredients. By eating them, Link's [[Stealth]] abilities will receive a boost. * '''Spicy Prime Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Prime Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The simple preparation of this steak dish belies its complex taste profile.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy Ingredients. They grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]] when he eats them. * '''Tough Prime Spiced Meat Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Prime Spiced Meat Skewer}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The simple preparation of this steak dish belies its complex taste profile.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough Ingredients. When these skewers are eaten, Link will gain a boost to his [[Defense]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Like in {{BotW}}, Prime Spiced Meat Skewers can be made by [[Cooking]] together [[Raw Prime Meat]] and [[Goron Spice]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Gourmet Spiced Meat Skewer * Food * Meal * Spiced Meat Skewer }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Skewers |items= BotW, TotK }}
